backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to involved files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file providing short descriptions of each frontend source file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining monochrome color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component assembling site sections and tracking active section via IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Minimalist about section with centered editorial brand copy.
frontend/src/components/CollectionSectio: Product grid rendering menswear items from static data.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form with local state, validation, and a temporary success message.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with background image, brand title, tagline, and scroll-to-collection button.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand info, navigation links, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header component with logo, desktop and mobile navigation, and smooth scrolling to sections.
frontend/src/data/collection.ts: Defines a Product interface and exports a static list of eight product objects with names, prices, and images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication using react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, login state, and persisted identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module noting no backend queries are needed and that product data is static.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base setup with custom OKLCH variables, dark mode tokens, and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts React, sets up react-query, Internet Identity, and global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH color tokens, extended theme options, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata including version, requirements, features, and image asset needs for the site.
